outlet: The Ritzville Adams County Journal (2025-07-09), "Washtucna pool needs TLC"
notes: Paywalled; visible: the Washtucna pool in Bassett Park had been empty about five years and leaks; Pool Board President Alta Hunt cited a $98,000 estimate to get it running and said the August 2025 levy asked voters for $80,000 of the repairs, which would also make the town eligible for grants.
